premise: Firefly blinks hello on her first summer night but nobody blinks back; Mouse stands on tiptoe to look, Hedgehog says to shine brighter, and at last, far over the meadow, little lights blink back.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling's finding your own kind (Andersen), turned: new friends help you look, and the answer was out there all along.
learning: Fireflies blink their lights to talk to each other.

en-US.title: Firefly Blinks Hello
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] It was the first warm evening of summer. {firefly:enter} Firefly's little tail {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} lit up. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink, she went. Hello! [pause] Nobody blinked back. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Blink, blink. Hello? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Mouse scampered up. [curious] "Who are you blinking at?" {firefly:live talk} "Anyone," said Firefly. "Blinking is how fireflies say hello." {mouse:live sniff hold} Mouse stood up on his tiptoes and looked. And looked. No lights anywhere. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Hedgehog came snuffling through the grass. {hedgehog:live talk} "Try blinking BRIGHTER," he said. So Firefly closed her eyes and {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} glowed her very brightest. [whispers] Everyone waited. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Then, far across the meadow… a tiny light blinked. And another. And another! {mouse:live sniff resume} Mouse dropped down and washed his whiskers, very pleased. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Firefly blinked back: blink, blink. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} "Hello, hello!" {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] And Hedgehog {hedgehog:live curl hold} curled up in the grass, snug as a ball, with little lights twinkling all around. {canvas:fireflies stop}

es-ES.title: Luciérnaga dice hola
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] Era la primera tarde calurosa del verano. A {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga se le {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} encendió la colita. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Encendió, apagó, encendió: ¡hola! [pause] Nadie le contestó. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Encendió, apagó. ¿Hola? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Ratón llegó correteando. [curious] —¿A quién le haces guiños? {firefly:live talk} —A cualquiera —dijo Luciérnaga—. Así es como saludamos las luciérnagas. {mouse:live sniff hold} Ratón se puso de puntillas y miró. Y miró. Ni una luz. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Erizo llegó husmeando entre la hierba. {hedgehog:live talk} —Prueba a brillar MÁS fuerte —dijo. Así que Luciérnaga cerró los ojos y {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} brilló con todas sus fuerzas. [whispers] Todos esperaron. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Y entonces, al otro lado del prado… parpadeó una lucecita. Y otra. ¡Y otra más! {mouse:live sniff resume} Ratón bajó y se lavó los bigotes, muy contento. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Luciérnaga contestó: encendió, apagó. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} —¡Hola, hola! {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] Y Erizo {hedgehog:live curl hold} se hizo una bolita en la hierba, rodeado de lucecitas. {canvas:fireflies stop}

ja-JP.title: ホタルさんの こんばんは
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6}[softly]なつのはじめの、あたたかいゆうがた。{firefly:enter}ホタルさんのおしりが、{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}ぽうっ。{firefly:face happy}{sfx:twinkle}ぴか、ぴか。こんばんは！[pause]…だれも、ぴかってくれない。{canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}{firefly:face sad}[sad]ぴか、ぴか。こんばんは？{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to firefly}ネズミくんが、ちょろちょろ。[curious]「だれに、ぴかぴかしてるの？」 {firefly:live talk}「だれにでも。ホタルはね、ひかってあいさつするの。」 {mouse:live sniff hold}ネズミくんは、つまさきだちで、じーっ。あかりは、どこにもありません。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to firefly}ハリネズミくんが、くんくんやってきて、{hedgehog:live talk}「もっと、あかるくひかってみたら？」 そこでホタルさんは、目をとじて、{firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A}せいいっぱい、ぴかーっ！[whispers]みんな、じっとまちました。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}すると、はらっぱのずっとむこうで…小さなあかりが、ぴかっ。またひとつ。またひとつ！{mouse:live sniff resume}ネズミくんはおりて、うれしそうにひげをごしごし。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}ホタルさんも、ぴか、ぴか。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}「こんばんは、こんばんは！」 {hedgehog:face sleeping}[happily]ハリネズミくんは、{hedgehog:live curl hold}まんまるくなりました。まわりで、小さなあかりが、ちかちか。{canvas:fireflies stop}

de-DE.title: Das Glühwürmchen blinkt Hallo
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] Es war der erste warme Sommerabend. {firefly:enter} Beim Glühwürmchen {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} leuchtete das Schwänzchen auf. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink, machte es. Hallo! [pause] Niemand blinkte zurück. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Blink, blink. Hallo? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Die Maus kam angeflitzt. [curious] „Wem blinkst du denn zu?“ {firefly:live talk} „Irgendwem“, sagte das Glühwürmchen. „Mit Blinken sagen Glühwürmchen Hallo.“ {mouse:live sniff hold} Die Maus stellte sich auf die Zehenspitzen und schaute. Und schaute. Nirgends ein Licht. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Der Igel kam schnuffelnd durchs Gras. {hedgehog:live talk} „Blink mal HELLER“, sagte er. Da machte das Glühwürmchen die Augen zu und {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} leuchtete, so hell es nur konnte. [whispers] Alle warteten. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Dann, weit drüben auf der Wiese… blinkte ein winziges Licht. Und noch eins. Und noch eins! {mouse:live sniff resume} Die Maus plumpste zurück auf die Füße und putzte sich zufrieden die Schnurrhaare. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Das Glühwürmchen blinkte zurück: blink, blink. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} „Hallo, hallo!“ {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] Und der Igel {hedgehog:live curl hold} rollte sich im Gras zu einer kuscheligen Kugel ein, und ringsum funkelten kleine Lichter. {canvas:fireflies stop}

fr-FR.title: Luciole dit bonjour
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] C’était le premier soir chaud de l’été. La petite lanterne de {firefly:enter} Luciole {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} s’est allumée. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Clignote, clignote : bonjour ! [pause] Personne n’a répondu. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Clignote, clignote. Bonjour ? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Souris est arrivée en trottinant. [curious] « À qui tu fais des signes ? » {firefly:live talk} « À tout le monde, a dit Luciole. Les lucioles disent bonjour en clignotant. » {mouse:live sniff hold} Souris s’est mise sur la pointe des pieds. Elle a regardé, regardé. Pas une lumière. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Hérisson est arrivé en reniflant dans l’herbe. {hedgehog:live talk} « Essaie de briller plus FORT », a-t-il dit. Alors Luciole a fermé les yeux et {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} a brillé de toutes ses forces. [whispers] Tout le monde attendait. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Et puis, tout au bout du pré… une petite lumière a clignoté. Et une autre. Et encore une autre ! {mouse:live sniff resume} Souris est redescendue et s’est lavé les moustaches, toute contente. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Luciole a répondu : clignote, clignote. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} « Bonjour, bonjour ! » {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] Et Hérisson {hedgehog:live curl hold} s’est roulé en boule, bien au chaud, au milieu des petites lumières qui scintillaient. {canvas:fireflies stop}

it-IT.title: Lucciola dice ciao
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6} [softly] Era la prima sera calda d'estate. A {firefly:enter} Lucciola si è {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} accesa la codina. {firefly:face happy} {sfx:twinkle} Accendi e spegni, accendi e spegni: ciao! [pause] Nessuno ha risposto. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:face sad} [sad] Accendi e spegni. Ciao? {mouse:enter} {mouse:go to firefly} Topolino è arrivato di corsa. [curious] «A chi fai l'occhiolino?» {firefly:live talk} «A chiunque», ha detto Lucciola. «Noi lucciole ci salutiamo così, con la luce.» {mouse:live sniff hold} Topolino si è alzato in punta di piedi e ha guardato. E guardato. Nessuna luce, da nessuna parte. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to firefly} Riccio è arrivato annusando tra l'erba. {hedgehog:live talk} «Prova a brillare PIÙ forte», ha detto. Allora Lucciola ha chiuso gli occhi e {firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A} si è accesa più forte che poteva. [whispers] Tutti aspettavano. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Poi, lontano, dall'altra parte del prato… si è accesa una lucina. E un'altra. E un'altra ancora! {mouse:live sniff resume} Topolino è tornato giù e si è lavato i baffetti, tutto soddisfatto. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Lucciola ha risposto: accendi e spegni. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} «Ciao, ciao!» {hedgehog:face sleeping} [happily] E Riccio {hedgehog:live curl hold} si è chiuso a palla nell'erba, bello raccolto, con tante lucine che brillavano tutto intorno. {canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-TW.title: 螢火蟲閃閃說哈囉
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6}[softly]這是夏天第一個暖暖的傍晚。{firefly:enter}螢火蟲的小尾巴{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}亮了起來。{firefly:face happy}{sfx:twinkle}一閃，一閃。哈囉！[pause]沒有人閃回來。{canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}{firefly:face sad}[sad]一閃，一閃。哈囉？{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to firefly}小老鼠跑了過來。[curious]「你在對誰閃呀？」 {firefly:live talk}「誰都可以。」 螢火蟲說，「我們螢火蟲，就是用一閃一閃來打招呼的。」 {mouse:live sniff hold}小老鼠踮起腳尖，看呀看。哪裡都沒有亮光。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to firefly}刺蝟在草叢裡嗅呀嗅地走過來。{hedgehog:live talk}「再亮一點試試看！」 牠說。於是螢火蟲閉上眼睛，{firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A}亮出最亮最亮的光。[whispers]大家都在等。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}這時，在草地的另一頭……一個小亮光閃了一下。又一個。又一個！{mouse:live sniff resume}小老鼠放下腳，洗洗鬍鬚，好開心。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}螢火蟲也閃回去：一閃，一閃。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}「哈囉，哈囉！」 {hedgehog:face sleeping}[happily]刺蝟{hedgehog:live curl hold}在草叢裡縮成一顆暖暖的小球，身邊的小亮光，一閃一閃亮晶晶。{canvas:fireflies stop}

zh-HK.title: 螢火蟲閃燈打招呼
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6}[softly]這是夏天第一個暖和的黃昏。{firefly:enter}螢火蟲的小尾巴{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}亮了起來。{firefly:face happy}{sfx:twinkle}閃一閃，閃一閃。哈囉！[pause]沒有誰閃回來。{canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}{firefly:face sad}[sad]閃一閃，閃一閃。哈囉？{mouse:enter}{mouse:go to firefly}小老鼠跑了過來。[curious]「你對住邊個閃呀？」 {firefly:live talk}「邊個都得。」 螢火蟲說，「我哋螢火蟲，就係靠閃燈嚟打招呼㗎。」 {mouse:live sniff hold}小老鼠踮起腳尖，望呀望。到處都沒有光。{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to firefly}刺蝟在草叢裏嗅呀嗅地走過來。{hedgehog:live talk}「試吓閃得光啲啦！」 牠說。於是螢火蟲閉上眼睛，{firefly:glow 1 2s x4 #FFE27A}發出最亮最亮的光。[whispers]大家都在等。{canvas:fireflies 0.6}這時，在草地的另一邊……一點小光閃了一下。又一點。再一點！{mouse:live sniff resume}小老鼠放下腳跟，洗洗鬍鬚，開心極了。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}螢火蟲也閃回去：閃一閃，閃一閃。{firefly:face happy}{firefly:live wave}「哈囉，哈囉！」 {hedgehog:face sleeping}[happily]刺蝟{hedgehog:live curl hold}在草叢裏縮成一個暖暖的小球，身邊的小光點，閃呀閃呀。{canvas:fireflies stop}

twinkle.prompt: a tiny, soft twinkling chime, like a little light blinking on, magical and gentle

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording
